Decaymode: manual: use Decay. animate: Decay sweeps 0 to 1 and back over each preview cycle.
Decay: Amount of rust and corrosion, 0 (clean brushed steel) to 1 (heavily rusted and pitted). Used when Decaymode is manual.
Scale: Frequency of the rust noise in object space. Larger = smaller, finer patches.
Cavity: How much rust collects in concave and flat areas. 0 = rust ignores curvature.
Edgewear: How much convex edges wear back to bare metal. 0 = no edge wear.
Curvbias: Curvature threshold in 1/world units: surfaces below it collect rust, edges above 2x it wear to metal.
Pits: Amount of pitting inside rusted areas; appears once Decay is above about 0.4. 0 = none.
Pitsize: Size of the pits. Larger = bigger, sparser dimples.
Relief: Strength of the bump relief on rust and pits. 0 = flat shading.
Metalcolor: Colour of the clean brushed metal.
Rustcolor: Colour of the main orange rust.
Rustdark: Colour of deep, dark corrosion and pits.
Envrot: Rotation of the procedural studio lighting around the object, in degrees.
Envint: Brightness of the procedural studio lighting (the material is self-lit, no Light COMP needed).
Modamount: Scales the modulation CHOP (in1). band1 adds to the decay value. 0 = ignore modulation.
Speed: Preview only: speed of the decay animation and spin when Decaymode is animate.
Resolution: Preview only: size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Exposure: Preview only: brightness multiplier applied before tonemapping.
Bloom: Preview only: amount of glow around bright areas. 0 = none.
Spinturns: Preview only: whole revolutions the objects spin per animation cycle.
Tilt: Preview only: tilt of the torus knot in degrees.
Camdist: Preview only: camera distance in world units. Larger = objects look smaller.
Backdrop: Preview only: brightness of the background.
